# compiler-rt provenance

The upstream Windows amd64 build log (https://github.com/SagerNet/cronet-go/actions/runs/31190278364/job/92905042616) reports a compilation of compiler-rt atomic.obj. The pinned Naiveproxy DEPS revision for compiler-rt is 03641f7a5b05e48e318d64369057db577cafc594; LICENSE.TXT is from that revision. source/atomic.c is from https://github.com/SagerNet/naiveproxy/blob/510717a833c95a17218efc550fe6cac02414cad5/src/third_party/compiler-rt/src/lib/builtins/atomic.c , SHA-256 17e72d62c71b74291f23daba77d9a5452eae1e8dd09e54c872b9f0566292b162. Relative to the pinned compiler-rt upstream revision, the Naiveproxy copy comments out a two-line static assertion. The CI checkout contents and final linked binary require separate verification; this one file is not the complete source tree.
